import (

func main() {
	var engineConfig pkg.CrawlConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"respect_robots_txt":false}`), &engineConfig); err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("config parse failed: %v", err))

	if createErr != nil {

	url := `https://example.com`

	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
